summary.assessment: The model is dependable on two things: copying numbers that are printed next to the marks of a single-panel chart (B1, 12 of 12 exact) and staying silent on diagrams (four of five no-data figures returned no values; the fifth, the ECG traces, got 16 empty rows). Whenever a value has to come from a mark position it is unreliable, in 6 of the 10 data charts: marks land inside bars or beside points (C1: 7 of 12 bars 0.09-0.24 low; A3: all three centres about 0.03 high), and where no axis was calibrated it falls back to rounded guesses that are roughly right but flatten differences (B4, B5, C4). Multi-panel figures are its second weakness: panels were merged or lost in four of them (B3 five ROC panels into one with a fabricated 0.0-1.0 ramp, C3 two of three panels missing, C4 box plot dropped, B5 two panels merged and mislabelled), and one three-panel line figure produced nothing at all (B2). Only 3 of 10 data charts are usable as returned, and one of those (C5) was read by the engine's vector path without a model call. It can be trusted on single-panel charts with printed values and as a non-chart filter; its measured or estimated values and anything with several panels need verification before use.
